Haleon has seen an uptick in US sales of some of its over-the-counter products, including the pain reliever Advil and the antacid Tums, as users of GLP-1 weight-loss medications turn to the products to deal with side effects.
The consumer health company is even teaming up with stores including CVS
to have its products placed in areas frequented by weight-loss drugs patients.
"Dual ​placement in core aisles and GLP-1 destination sets delivers an average ​24% sales lift per store," a Haleon spokesperson told
, adding that items placed on designated GLP-1 shelves are outselling the same ones in stores without them.
The spokesperson added that the company has also been in discussions with Walmart

title: Haleon takes advantage of GLP-1 side effects as US sales rise
